request.query: Summing all monomials with their coefficients recovers a multivariate polynomial.

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_sum_monomial_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p) = p

items.name: MvPolynomial.as_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  p = ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p)

items.name: Polynomial.sum_monomial_eq
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => (Polynomial.monomial n) a) = p

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, Finsupp.sum p b = ∑ m ∈ p.support, b m (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_monomial_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {u : σ →₀ ℕ} {r : R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, b u 0 = 0 → Finsupp.sum ((MvPolynomial.monomial u) r) b = b u r

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_support
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), p = ∑ i ∈ p.support, (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), (Polynomial.monomial i) (p.coeff i)
